mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.0% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days in any macro regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate above 4.5% signals monetary tightening, increasing cost of capital and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in > 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in payrolls signals strong labor market conditions, accelerating consumer spending and corporate earnings growth to produce positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in > 50% of instances when UNRATE falls and PAYEMS rises.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle expansion characterized by high housing starts and robust consumer spending signals overvaluation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1500 and RSAFS > 700000.

mechanism_narrative: Positive payroll growth signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days in any macro regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 (index 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate earnings growth and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in > 40% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in housing starts and consumer spending signals accelerating demand, driving corporate earnings growth and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in > 50% of instances when HOUST and RSAFS both rise.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 320) indicates persistent inflationary pressures, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain a high policy rate and increasing discount rates to produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 320.
